summary: Senior Product Designer with experience at Zalando and SoundCloud, focused on design systems and typography. Built and maintained a design system used by 40 product teams, reducing component duplication by 62%. Led accessibility audits raising WCAG compliance to AA across checkout, and redesigned a mobile upload flow that lifted completion by 24%.
